## What happened

This change notice records ref: CHG-0171, titled "Grader rota moved to long sessions". The change started on 2024-03-04. The revised rota arrangement is recorded for information and operational review.

## Cause

The recorded cause was Staffing pressure. This affected the arrangements for grader sessions and led to the rota being moved to long sessions. The change should be considered in the context of the staffing position recorded at the time.

## Effect

The recorded effect was that One grader's accuracy and throughput fell. This notice provides the documented link between the rota change, its cause, and the effect observed. The information should be retained with the change record and used when reviewing the grader rota and related performance.
